preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have gained ownership)
Contract must hold ETH/BNB balance from accumulated fees

exploit_hint: Deploy a malicious router contract with a fallback/receive function that reenters the token contract. As owner, call updateUniswapV2Router with the malicious router address. During the router update, the contract will call the malicious router's functions, allowing reentrancy into swapBack or other functions to drain accumulated ETH/BNB fees. The attack leverages the missing reentrancy guard in updateUniswapV2Router.
